analyst.summary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments makes specialized high-voltage electrical gear for power grids and the energy transition, and has recently won a notable export order in Japan alongside solid domestic order flow. Growth and returns have been strong, but the stock is priced very richly, and its collection of receivables (how quickly it gets paid) has been slowing even as revenue grows -- worth watching closely. We rate it a Hold: a genuine niche energy-transition player, but priced for perfection with an emerging cash-conversion flag.
